MERCHANDISE COLLECTIVE AGREEMENT

This Merchandise Collective Agreement (the "Agreement") is made between Omar Haddad, Grace Liu and Nina Petrov (the "Members").

1. Purpose

1.1 The Members design and sell a joint line of printed apparel under the name "Third Shift" (the "Line").

2. Term

2.1 This Agreement takes effect on July 1, 2026 and ends on June 30, 2028.

3. Definitions

3.1 "Gross Sales" means all amounts paid by customers for products in the Line.

3.2 "Net Revenue" means Gross Sales less payment processing fees and marketplace fees.

3.3 Payment processing fees and marketplace fees are deducted from Gross Sales before the split.

4. Shares

4.1 Omar Haddad receives 40% of Net Revenue.

4.2 Grace Liu receives 35% of Net Revenue.

4.3 Nina Petrov receives 25% of Net Revenue.

5. Refunds and Returns

5.1 Customers may return unworn items within thirty (30) days of delivery.

5.2 Any refunds, chargebacks or credits issued to customers shall be deducted from future Net Revenue.

5.3 The Members will review the level of returns every six (6) months.

6. Inventory

6.1 Unsold stock is held by Grace Liu and remains the joint property of the Members.

7. General

7.1 This Agreement may only be changed in writing signed by all Members.

Signed by Omar Haddad, Grace Liu and Nina Petrov.
